vectors.description: R02-r3-001: the Deck (warm session, tracker n = 0 so prior' = claim x 700/1000) against the phone (battery 600 permille, thermal 1, user active); the spec's own numbers
cold session and a cold model: E1 adds 3 x rtt + 40, E2 adds ceilDiv(fileBytes, 1,000,000)
STALE state: queue bucket 1 becomes 2 (30,000 ms) and S6 = 25% of the total
EXPIRED state: last-known fast fields are used as they are and S6 = 50% of the total
zero-ish: P = 1, no body bytes, N = 1 (no decode time)
N from the per-app output EWMA when no cap is ruled
N defaults to 256 with neither a cap nor an EWMA
N is clamped to 32,768
S2: this device on battery at 500 permille (multiplier 1000 at >= 500, 2000 at 200..499, 4000 below 200)
S2: this device on battery at 499 permille (multiplier 1000 at >= 500, 2000 at 200..499, 4000 below 200)
S2: this device on battery at 200 permille (multiplier 1000 at >= 500, 2000 at 200..499, 4000 below 200)
S2: this device on battery at 199 permille (multiplier 1000 at >= 500, 2000 at 200..499, 4000 below 200)
S2 is 0 on mains or while charging
S2: an EXPIRED peer on battery at band lt20 has multiplier 4000 (F11 is skipped when EXPIRED)
S2: a peer on battery at band 50-79 has multiplier 1000
S3: this device, user active, thermal code 1: heat 500 permille
S3: this device, not user active, thermal code 1: heat 250 permille
S3: this device, thermal code 0: no heat
S3: a warm handheld peer at band 1: heat 250 permille (peers are always 250)
S3: a desktop is never charged for heat
E7: thermal code 2 on this device takes the hot branch min(dec, steady)
E7: throttle onset crossed while decoding: coolMs at the decode rate, the rest at the steady rate
E7: already past the onset (busy time counts) takes the hot branch
E6: the claim decode is the curve at P (between two points, floor division)
E6: P above the last curve point is clamped to it
E6: P below the first curve point is clamped to it
tracker n = 3: the lower median of the kept ratios scales every rate (min(1000, median))
tracker n = 2: the blend (2 x prior' + sum(claim x min(1000, x))) / (2 + n)
capRef: the class ceiling (below the claim) is the binding term of prior' while n < 3
capRef: a signed reference p90 x 12/10 is the binding term
the peer-wide discount: two DISCREPANT keys of one peer make disc 400 instead of 700
S5, virtual selector: rank difference x 5,000, and an unranked file counts as best + 10
S5, concrete model: no rank term
S5: the quantisation penalty table, an unknown quantisation and a missing one (1,000)
E2: this device, file not loaded: ceilDiv(fileBytes, 500,000) for a phone
E3: own reservations above the queue bucket win the max
E3: queue bucket 2 is 30,000 ms
E3: this device uses its own local queue
E1: an unmeasured bandwidth uses the path default (OVERLAY 20,000 kbit/s)
E11: a peer's power class default (DESKTOP 150,000 mW) when the claim has no power
usable gate: decEff 3,999 is below 4,000 (peers only)
usable gate: decEff 4,000 passes
usable gate: ttft over 20,000 ms fails
usable gate: total over the deadline fails
this device is not subject to the usability gate (D9)
saturation: a load time beyond 2^53 - 1 saturates and the sum saturates too
tracker n = 6 of ratio 400 (DISCREPANT), live state on the claim's own backend: every rate is scaled by the lower median 400 (prefill 24,000, decode 4,800)
the same tracker after the peer's live state switches to backend vulkan: the tracker is keyed (peer, file), so the placement rate is the same (LTQ-01)
S6 charges the worse of the digest class and the power class: a FRESH digest with STALE power fields is 25% of the total, and the band 'ge80' reads 50-79 (LTQ-06)
S6 with EXPIRED power fields and a FRESH digest is 50% of the total (LTQ-06)
